landsat.index_method: explicit ratio on nonnegative reflectance; positive denominator
landsat.scene_to_grid: reduceResolution(mean); native support weighted by output-cell overlap
landsat.temporal_composite: median AFTER scene aggregation to common grid

ghsl.spatial_method: native built_surface/native projected cell area; overlap-weighted mean to common grid

hotspot.threshold_population: LST: valid in both seasons; built: all valid boundary cells

weather.location_method: selected cell center nearest built-fraction-weighted hotspot centroid; row-major tie
weather.extraction_method: Image.sample at hotspot point; exact native projection; no scale/factor/numPixels; dropNulls=False
weather.target_temperature_wind: sample at interval midpoint; bracketed linear interpolation only

shortwave_physical_qc.operation: negative source increments in [-5,0) J/m2 set to 0 for model input only
shortwave_physical_qc.larger_negative_policy: hard failure requiring provider source review
shortwave_physical_qc.raw_policy: preserve every acquired value and acquisition artifact exactly
shortwave_physical_qc.basis: explicit user-approved provider shortwave quantization/deaccumulation physical QC

pcm_screen.lower_statistic: mean of complete local daily Tmax from hourly hotspot T_air_C
pcm_screen.air_missing_policy: fail on missing/duplicate/extra hours or days; no interpolation/substitution
pcm_screen.pass_equation: Tm_high_C >= lower_C AND Tm_low_C <= upper_C; PCM_RUNNABLE only
pcm_screen.table: Section-0 PCM_RUNNABLE only; all workbook rows retained for audit

download.cache_policy: write acquired artifacts only; no automatic cache reads

native_projection.wkt:
PROJCS["World_Mollweide", 
  GEOGCS["WGS 84", 
    DATUM["WGS_1984", 
      SPHEROID["WGS 84", 6378137.0, 298.257223563, AUTHORITY["EPSG","7030"]], 
      AUTHORITY["EPSG","6326"]], 
    PRIMEM["Greenwich", 0.0], 
    UNIT["degree", 0.017453292519943295], 
    AXIS["Longitude", EAST], 
    AXIS["Latitude", NORTH]], 
  PROJECTION["Mollweide"], 
  PARAMETER["semi_minor", 6378137.0], 
  PARAMETER["false_easting", 0.0], 
  PARAMETER["false_northing", 0.0], 
  PARAMETER["central_meridian", 0.0], 
  UNIT["m", 1.0], 
  AXIS["Easting", EAST], 
  AXIS["Northing", NORTH]]

aggregation: native built_surface/native projected cell area; overlap-weighted mean to common grid
